Implemented and pushed: Gerrit change 1798 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1798), commit 0f5900212d, trailer rebar-ticket: 8274-6714-32b6-48be. Awaiting LLM-Review/Verified; NOT submitted, ticket stays in_progress.

As implemented: resolve_bedrock_region(bedrock_region_name) in src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py returns (region, source) — REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > (None, None)=boto3/profile; empty strings treated as unset; build_bedrock_provider passes the result explicitly as region_name= so botocore's AWS_REGION quirk is bypassed. Error message rewritten to name the full chain (stale 'does NOT resolve' paragraph dropped; IMDS note kept). provenance_for (capabilities.py) gained bedrock_region_name kwarg; records region+region_source verbatim on bedrock runs when rebar's chain resolved (absent for profile-only resolution and non-bedrock providers); runner threads cfg.bedrock_region_name (+1 line, runner.py 797/800).

TDD: 11 new tests written RED first (5 in test_bedrock_provider.py incl. the rewritten 4e71 oracle — botocore still measured ignoring AWS_REGION, rebar now closes it; 6 in test_verdict_provenance.py). Hand-mutant kill rate on resolve_bedrock_region: 9/9 (100%) — chain reorder, dropped arms, truthiness inversions, swapped/hardcoded source labels, wrong fallthrough sentinel.

Gates: make lint clean; make typecheck clean (542 files); complexity ratchet active=51 new=0 increased=0; module cap respected. Targeted suites green: test_bedrock_provider + test_verdict_provenance(+wiring) + test_ci_provider_matrix + test_web_tool_gating + code-review provenance = 138 passed. Docs updated: docs/llm-framework.md (region bullet + env table row), docs/local-dev-env.md.

Unrelated observation: tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py has 5 failures on THIS HOST that reproduce identically on pristine origin/main (throwaway worktree) — environmental, not caused by this change; not pursued here.
